keyword: where is the baseball classic being played
claims: LoanDepot park in Miami, FL hosts Pool D, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, and Final of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Minute Maid Park in Houston, TX hosts Pool B and Quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan hosts Pool C of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, PR hosts Pool A of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic runs from March 5-17, 2026.
According to MLB.com, the championship game of the 2026 World Baseball Classic takes place on March 17 in Miami
